2608.21423.title: Agentic Security: A Systematization of Tools, Failure Modes, and Design Laws for LLM-Driven Penetration Testing
2608.21423.paper_summary: Agentic security uses large-language-model (LLM) agents to plan, dispatch, and interpret security tools. As these systems move from demonstrations to deployed products, practitioners repeatedly encounter the same operational failures. We systematize these failures through a hands-on evaluation of ten widely used static, dynamic, cloud, orchestration, and AI red-teaming tools for unattended pipelines. We introduce a four-dimensional Integration Friction Index that separates one-time engineering cost from recurring organisational, legal, and maintenance cost. We then derive quantitative regularities that explain recurring failure modes. Modelling an agentic security system as stochastic LLM policies wrapped by a deterministic mediator, we show that long-lived sessions lose resident evidence with phase count, while short-lived sub-agents extend the usable horizon according to the compression ratio between raw evidence and its summary. We show that a two-stage verdict cascade multiplies scorer likelihood ratios, but provides little benefit when scorer errors correlate. We show that treating unevaluable outcomes as attack failures biases downstream measurements toward evasive and severe responses. We formulate planner-versus-worker model routing as a knapsack problem and derive a closed-form execution cap for heavy-tailed tools, eta* = alpha v/c. Finally, we show why scope and budget enforcement cannot be delegated to system prompts: prompts do not constrain what actually executes. Inspectra, our implemented platform, serves as a worked instantiation, with mechanisms labelled shipped, partial, or planned, including those that did not work.
2608.21423.paper_summary_zh: 代理安全使用大型語言模型（LLM）代理來規劃、派遣和解釋安全工具。隨著這些系統從演示轉向部署產品，實踐者不斷遇到相同的操作失敗。我們通過對十種廣泛使用的靜態、動態、雲端、編排和 AI 紅隊工具進行實地評估，系統化這些失敗，這些工具用於無人值守的管道。我們引入了一個四維整合摩擦指數，將一次性工程成本與反覆出現的組織、法律和維護成本區分開來。然後，我們推導出解釋反覆失敗模式的定量規律。將代理安全系統建模為由確定性中介包裹的隨機 LLM 策略，我們顯示長期會話隨著階段數的增加而失去常駐證據，而短期子代理根據原始證據及其摘要之間的壓縮比擴展可用的範圍。我們顯示，兩階段裁決級聯會乘以評分者的可能性比率，但在評分者錯誤相關時提供的好處不大。我們顯示，將無法評估的結果視為攻擊失敗會使下游測量偏向於逃避和嚴重的反應。我們將規劃者與工作者模型路由公式化為背包問題，並推導出重尾工具的封閉形式執行上限，eta* = alpha v/c。最後，我們展示為什麼範圍和預算執行不能委託給系統提示：提示並不限制實際執行的內容。我們實施的平台 Inspectra 作為一個具體的實例，具有標記為已發貨、部分或計劃的機制，包括那些未能運作的部分。
